title: SHARE IT Source Code Repository Discovery Form
description:
This intake form serves as a simple registry for gathering basic information about a source code repository. Responses will be used by the NIH to help repository managers and owners comply with the SHARE IT Act of 2024.

Please fill in the repository information below for each question, and then click the 'Generate your response!' button.

Once your response is generated, you can:

  • Copy the response from the text box and paste it into your own email to be sent to our team
  • Download the response as a text file
  • Create a GitHub issue by clicking the 'Create a GitHub Issue' button
  • Click the 'Email' button to open your default email client with the response pre-filled in the body of the email

Repository Name.description: Name of the repository where the feedback is submitted

Repository URL.description: URL of the repository where the feedback is submitted

Repository Type.description: Type of repository where the feedback is submitted

FISMA System Identifier (if applicable).description: Please provide the FISMA System Identifier

Technical Custodian/Administrator.description: Name of the technical custodian or administrator

Contractor Status.description: Indicates if the repository is operated by an employee or a contractor

Last Updated.description: Date when the repository was last updated
